name: Should I insulate my garage before installing drywall?

mainEntity.name: Should I insulate my garage before installing drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insulation is strongly recommended before hanging garage drywall, especially across the Denver and Aurora metro areas where winter temperatures routinely drop below freezing. Adding insulation stabilizes interior temperatures, protects stored items, and prevents cold air from transferring into adjacent living spaces or overhead bedrooms. If you only plan to store vehicles and never heat the garage, uninsulated drywall provides a clean, fire-resistant surface, but you give up thermal protection and sound dampening that is impossible to install later without tearing down wallboard.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, insulating before hanging drywall protects against seasonal Colorado temperature swings, lowers heat loss into adjacent living rooms, and buffers noise.
